title: Van Allen radiation belt impassable

tellings.quote: Danny brings this up on his podcast where James Van Allen who you know it's named after is saying that is 150 times what a normal human can take radiation wise

plain: The Van Allen belts are bands of radiation circling the Earth, and the physicist they are named after, James Van Allen, is said to have warned that their radiation was 150 times what a human body can take. Michels passes this on from the podcaster Danny Jones, who raised it on his own show, and he also mentions the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun. It matters because, if true, it would raise questions about how astronauts could safely pass through the belts in the 1960s.
